title: As US ties fray, Europe plans first undersea cable link to Greenland
gist: The EU's new Arctic strategy names a Pan-Arctic Cable as a flagship project to link Greenland directly to Europe, possibly extending via Canada to Japan and South Korea while bypassing the US. Analysts say cable routing is now driven by geopolitics, amid Red Sea, Baltic, Taiwan and Hormuz threats to subsea infrastructure.
